latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Translation: Update hu.json by @summoner001 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3480
* Update ru.json by @solokot in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3483
* Update German translation for deselect message by @jgkirschbaum in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3484
* Update uk.json by @PavloPogonets in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3485
* Root installer: install into profile Obtainium runs in, not the foreground user by @wiyba in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3487
* Update farsroid API by @facaikotei in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3489
* Translation: Update es.json by @Dio77799 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3503
* Translation: Update fr.json by @Manavagg2003 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3506
* Translation: Update nl.json by @Manavagg2003 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3507
* Translation: Update it.json by @Manavagg2003 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3508
* Translation: Update pt.json by @Manavagg2003 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3509
* Allow parentheses in HTML source link extraction (#3497) by @Manavagg2003 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3512
* l10n(sv): translate common update actions by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3516
* l10n(sv): translate app list actions by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3517
* Show updates for pseudo-versioned apps when downgrades are hidden by @ibrahim-iqbal in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3524
* Add an optional refresh button for phones (#698) by @DevShoaib78 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3535
* Open an app's page from Settings > App info > App details (SHOW_APP_INFO) by @sybenx in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3536
* l10n(sv): translate update health interface by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3519
* l10n(sv): translate import and export messages by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3520
* l10n(sv): translate source status interface by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3521
* l10n(sv): translate signing certificate verification by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3522
* l10n(sv): translate category and app actions by @yeager in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3518
* Add setting to toggle update checks for system-disabled apps by @VVispy in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3539
* By @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3541:
    * Preserve tracked versions when importing pseudo-versioned apps (#3531)
    * Harden app imports against path traversal and package-ID bypasses (#3527)
    * Use neutral update-health wording for stale-only flags (#3511)
    * Support GitHub Enterprise API URLs and scope overridden-host credentials (#3500)
    * Flush app JSON writes before renaming to reduce corruption risk (#3492)
    * Accept signing-key rotation lineages during install verification (#3490)
    * Fall back to internal cache when external storage is unwritable (#3488)
    * Cache F-Droid repository indexes and revalidate with ETag/Last-Modified (#3486)
    * Bypass the low-target-SDK install block for legacy root installs (#3478)
    * Paginate Forgejo releases so Codeberg filters can reach older stable builds (#3533)
* Translation: Update hu.json by @summoner001 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3543
* Fix TV focus ring shapes by @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3545
* Translation: Complete and update French localization (fr.json) by @Mickael81 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3529

detail.readme: # ![Obtainium Icon](./assets/graphics/icon_small.png) Obtainium Get Android app updates straight from the source. Obtainium allows you to install and update apps directly from their releases pages, and receive notifications when new releases are made available. More info: - [Obtainium Wiki](https://wiki.obtainium.imranr.dev/) ([repository](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium-Wiki)) - [Deep Links](https://wiki.obtainium.imranr.dev/deep_links/) - link straight to an import, or add a badge to your own project - [Obtainium 101](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0MF_v2OBncw) - Tutorial video - ["Verified Apps"](https://github.com/privacyguides/verified-apps-android) - App verification tool (recommended, integrates with Obtainium) - [apps.obtainium.imranr.dev](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/) - Crowdsourced app configurations ([repository](https://github.com/ImranR98/apps.obtainium.imranr.dev)) - [Side Of Burritos - You should use this instead of F-Droid | How to use app RSS feed](https://youtu.be/FFz57zNR_M0) - Original motivation for this app - [Website](https://obtainium.imranr.dev) ([repository](https://github.com/ImranR98/obtainium.imranr.dev)) Currently supported App sources: - Open Source - General: - [GitHub](https://github.com/) - [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/) - [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/) ([Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/)) - [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/) - Third Party F-Droid Repos - [IzzyOnDroid](https://android.izzysoft.de/) - [SourceHut](https://git.sr.ht/) - Other - General: - [APKPure](https://apkpure.net/) - [Aptoide](https://aptoide.com/) - [Uptodown](https://uptodown.com/) - [itch.io](https://itch.io/) - [Huawei AppGallery](https://appgallery.huawei.com/) - [Tencent App Store](https://sj.qq.com/) - [vivo App Store (CN)](https://h5.appstore.vivo.com.cn/) - [RuStore](https://rustore.ru/) - [Farsroid](https://www.farsroid.com) - [Samsung Galaxy Store](https://galaxystore.samsung.com/) - [LiteAPKs](https://liteapks.com/) - [APK4Free](https://apk4free.net/) - [CoolApk](https://coolapk.com/) - [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/) - Jenkins Jobs - [APKMirror](https://apkmirror.com/) *(Track-Only)* - [RockMods](https://rockmods.net/) *(Track-Only)* - Other - App-Specific: - [Telegram App](https://telegram.org/) - [Neutron Code](https://neutroncode.com/) - Direct APK Link - "HTML" (Fallback): Any other URL that returns an HTML page with links to APK files ## Finding App Configurations You can find crowdsourced app configurations at [apps.obtainium.imranr.dev](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev). If you can't find the configuration for an app you want, feel free to leave a request on the [issues page](https://github.com/ImranR98/apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/issues). Or, contribute some configurations to the website by creating a PR at [this repo](https://github.com/ImranR98/apps.obtainium.imranr.dev). ## Installation [](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/releases) [](https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/index/apk/dev.imranr.obtainium) [](https://f-droid.org/packages/dev.imranr.obtainium.fdroid/) Verification info: - Package name: `dev.imranr.obtainium` - SHA-256 hash of signing certificate: ```text B3:53:60:1F:6A:1D:5F:D6:60:3A:E2:F5:0B:E8:0C:F3:01:36:7B:86:B6:AB:8B:1F:66:24:3D:A9:6C:D5:73:62 ``` - Note: The above signature is also valid for the F-Droid flavour of Obtainium, thanks to [reproducible builds](https://f-droid.org/docs/Reproducible_Builds/). - PGP Public Key (to verify APK hashes): [pgp-public-key.asc](pgp-public-key.asc) - Fingerprint: `8E27 EC48 A4FE 21C7 1055 E2E3 C4EB 2B69 C138 EBEA` - Also available via [GitHub](https://github.com/ImranR98.gpg) and [keyserver.ubuntu.com](https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0x8e27ec48a4fe21c71055e2e3c4eb2b69c138ebea) ## Contributing / Developing Please see the pertinent documentation, [on contributing](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [the developer guide](docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md) (architecture description). ## Limitations - For some sources, data is gathered using Web scraping and can easily break due to changes in website design. In such cases, more reliable methods may be unavailable. ## Screenshots | | | | | ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | | | | |
